title: Record and allocate payments from the prospectus CLI (admins, for agents)
description:
Ryan wants agents to record payments for him (2026-10-31), so the `prospectus` command needs billing commands for admins. An agent signs in with `prospectus login --remote` as an admin, and the server checks admin authority on every call.

Commands, as a first cut (refine in the spec):
- `prospectus billing invoices [--account ID] [--status open|partially_paid|paid|uncollectible]`: list invoices with balances.
- `prospectus billing invoice show NUMBER` and `prospectus billing invoice pdf NUMBER [-o FILE]`.
- `prospectus billing payment record --account ID --amount 1234.56 --method bank_transfer|check|cash|other --received YYYY-MM-DD [--reference TEXT] [--note TEXT] [--allocate NUMBER=AMOUNT ...]`: records one external payment and optionally allocates it across one or more invoices.
- `prospectus billing payment allocate PAYMENT_ID NUMBER=AMOUNT ...`: allocate an unallocated remainder later.
- `prospectus billing invoice write-off NUMBER --reason TEXT`.

Rules:
- Amounts are USD, parsed into integer cents.
- Every write sends a client-generated operation id, so a retried command never records a payment twice.
- Before writing, the CLI prints what it will record, and supports `--yes` for agents.
- Refusals (not an admin, over-allocation, wrong account) come back as clear messages.
- Specs use a fake API; no network.

Depends on the prospectus command (kanbus-ee0248) and on the payments and allocations API (kanbus-0f125f).

Done when an admin's CLI session can record a payment that is split across two invoices, the invoices show the new balances, and a non-admin session is refused.
